repo_notes.content: This repository was completely replaced in 2026-11. Everything in the working tree is the NEW project: a Windows-only desktop app written in C++17 with Qt 6.9 (Qt Quick/QML and QtWebEngine), plus a Python command-line tool `cool.py` in the `cli/` folder. Ignore anything you may know about an earlier version of this repository that used Electron, React, TypeScript, node-pty, a `desktop/` folder or a PyQt6 `gui/` folder: those no longer exist and only appear in old git history. Do not mention them.

The desktop app is a thin shell around cool.py: login, reports, opening course links and cookies are all performed by running `python cli/cool.py ...` as a child process (see backend_cli.inc). The app only parses its output and syncs files (accounts.json, urls.txt, colors.json, cookies/, avatars/) with the CLI.

Only these C++ files are compiled (see CMakeLists.txt): main.cpp, backend.cpp (which #includes backend_native.inc and backend_cli.inc), color_engine.cpp, conpty.cpp, qml_pty_bridge.cpp, native.cpp. QML lives in qml/, the embedded terminal page and xterm.js assets in xterm/, and bundled ConPTY binaries in conpty/ (third-party, from Windows Terminal).

cool.py command flow: lineedit.py (input) -> repl.py (splits a line on && | ; and expands parenthesised groups) -> dispatch.py (command table and -h help) -> modifiers.py (parses `> /show /timer /delay /at /repeat /clear /exit`) -> runner.py (waiting, repeating, time limits) -> commands/ (account.py, urls.py, time_report.py). help.py holds all help text.

pages.title: Overview
pages.purpose: What the project is: a Qt/QML Windows desktop shell around the cool.py CLI for managing Cool English accounts, course links and learning-time reports.

pages.title: Desktop application architecture
pages.purpose: C++ Backend object, QML pages, how the backend talks to the CLI, DPAPI storage and file synchronisation.

pages.title: Embedded terminal
pages.purpose: xterm.js over QWebChannel connected to Windows ConPTY: tabs, history replay, handshake replies, resizing.

pages.title: cool.py command line tool
pages.purpose: Commands, the dispatcher, the `>` modifier timeline (delay/at, timer, clear/exit), parenthesised groups and chaining.

pages.title: Theming and colour engine
pages.purpose: OKLCH palette generation, contrast checks and the 24 theme presets.

pages.title: Building and running
pages.purpose: Qt 6.9.3 MSVC toolchain, rebuild.bat, deploy_main.bat and environment variables such as COOL_DATA_DIR and COOL_CLI_DIR.
